zh_CN: 找到米拉，用英语问候，或用手势确认善意
en: Find Mira and greet her in English, or use a friendly gesture

zh_CN: 用英语向塔维请求食物（%d/2）
en: Ask Tavi for food in English (%d/2)

zh_CN: 回到庇护所休息，结束第一天
en: Return to your shelter and end the first day

zh_CN: 用英语向维什请求合金零件（%d/2）
en: Ask Vesh for alloy parts in English (%d/2)

zh_CN: 回到庇护所休息，结束第二天
en: Return to your shelter and end the second day

zh_CN: 用英语向奥里请求一壶水
en: Ask Ori for a canteen of water in English

zh_CN: 把水带给罗文，并表达你的帮助意图
en: Bring the water to Rowan and offer your help

zh_CN: 纵向切片完成：你在异乡有了第一个立足点
en: Vertical slice complete: you found your first foothold

zh_CN: 捡到一块还能用的合金零件。
加热器恢复运转，庇护所暖了起来。
en: The heater is running again. The shelter feels warmer.

zh_CN: 今晚先活下来。加热器明天再修。
en: Survive tonight first. The heater can wait until tomorrow.

zh_CN: 他们谨慎地打量着这位异乡人。
en: They study the stranger with care.

zh_CN: 塔维会给饿肚子的人分食物。用英语向她要。
en: Tavi shares food with the hungry. Ask her in English.

zh_CN: 夜里会冷。维什收着旧合金，用英语向他要。
en: Nights get cold. Vesh keeps the old alloy; ask him in English.

zh_CN: 罗文今天缺水。先去向奥里要一壶水。
en: Rowan needs water today. Ask Ori for a canteen first.

zh_CN: 你昨天来过。摊位还留着你的位置。
en: You came yesterday. The stall still keeps your place.

zh_CN: 我走不动了。先去向奥里要水。
en: I cannot walk that far. Ask Ori for water first.
You brought water. I will not forget.

zh_CN: 我能分你食物。用英语告诉我你想吃。
en: I can share food. Tell me in English.
If you have enough fruit, go rest.

zh_CN: 加热器要合金零件。用英语向我要。
en: The heater needs alloy parts. Ask me in English.
If you have the parts, go to the furnace.

zh_CN: 蓄水器归我看管。用英语向我要水。
en: I keep the reservoir. Ask me for water in English.

zh_CN: 水已经在你身上。去罗文那里。
en: The water is already with you. Go to Rowan.

zh_CN: 米拉朝你招手：小家伙，到市场这边来。
en: Mira waves: Little one, come to the market.

zh_CN: 罗文远远看着你：先找水和暖和地方。
en: Rowan watches: Find water and warmth first.

zh_CN: 塔维对你笑：饿了吗？等安顿下来跟我说。
en: Tavi smiles: Hungry? Tell me once you are settled.

zh_CN: 维什敲了敲旧合金：夜里冷，缺零件来找我。
en: Vesh taps old alloy: Cold nights; come to me for parts.

zh_CN: 奥里护着水罐：需要水的时候来问我要。
en: Ori guards the canteen: Ask me when you need water.

zh_CN: %s 看懂了你的手势。你随时可以免费重试英语。
en: %s understands your gesture. You can retry English at no cost.

zh_CN: 靠近居民后使用“说话”，或选择“手势”确认。
en: Use Speak near a resident, or choose Gesture.

zh_CN: 今天还有重要的事没有完成。
en: There is still something important to do today.

zh_CN: 先去和市场的米拉打个招呼。
en: Greet Mira at the market first.
Bring back two duskberries before you sleep.

zh_CN: 今晚太冷。先修好加热器。
en: It is too cold tonight. Repair the heater first.
Rowan is still waiting for water. You cannot sleep yet.

zh_CN: 你昏倒后被送回庇护所。时间流逝了，但关系没有受损。
en: You were carried back to the shelter. Time passed, but no relationship was harmed.

zh_CN: 无法保存进度，但可以继续本次游戏。
en: Progress could not be saved, but this run can continue.

zh_CN: 靠近一位居民后使用“说话”输入；也可直接使用手势。
en: Move near a resident and use Speak; Gesture is always available.

zh_CN: 语音输入正忙；可以取消等待或使用手势继续。
en: Speech input is busy; cancel the wait or continue with Gesture.

zh_CN: 在第一天主动表达了善意
en: Offered kindness on the first day
Brought water when it was needed

zh_CN: 麦克风暂不可用；可以使用手势继续。
en: The microphone is unavailable; continue with Gesture.

zh_CN: 没有录到足够的声音；可以重试或使用手势。
en: Not enough audio was captured; retry or use Gesture.

zh_CN: 这次录音没有保存下来；可以重试或使用手势。
en: The recording could not be saved; retry or use Gesture.

zh_CN: 这次录音无法读取；可以重试或使用手势。
en: The recording could not be read; retry or use Gesture.

zh_CN: 本地语音暂不可用；可以免费重试或使用手势。
en: Local speech is unavailable; retry at no cost or use Gesture.

zh_CN: 没有读懂这次结果；可以免费重试或使用手势。
en: The result could not be understood; retry at no cost or use Gesture.

zh_CN: 可以免费重试，或使用手势继续。
en: Retry at no cost, or continue with Gesture.

zh_CN: 录音为空或过长；可以重试或使用手势。
en: The recording was empty or too long; retry or use Gesture.

zh_CN: 无需等待：[%s] 可改用手势 · [%s] 取消
en: No need to wait: [%s] use Gesture · [%s] Cancel
%s · That was not clear, and that is okay

zh_CN: [%s] 免费重试 · [%s] 使用手势 · [%s] 取消
晨光落在陌生屋顶上。你已经认得一条回家的路。
en: Morning light falls across unfamiliar roofs. One path now feels like home.

zh_CN: 聚落不再只是一张地图。有人开始期待你回来。
en: The settlement is no longer just a map. Someone expects you to return.

zh_CN: 引导期间生存需求不会下降。
en: Survival needs are protected during the guide.

zh_CN: 用 WASD / 左摇杆移动。四处走走看。
en: Move with WASD / the left stick. Walk around.

zh_CN: 移动鼠标 / 右摇杆环顾四周。
en: Move the mouse / right stick to look around.

zh_CN: 按住 Shift / 按下左摇杆冲刺。
en: Hold Shift / press the left stick to sprint.

zh_CN: 按空格 / 手柄南键跳跃。
en: Press Space / the South button to jump.

zh_CN: 靠近发亮的物体或居民，按 E / 西键互动。
en: Approach a glowing object or resident and press E / the West button.

zh_CN: 对塔维按 V 说英语，或按 G 用手势要一份食物。
en: Speak to Tavi with V, or use G to ask for food by gesture.

zh_CN: 回到庇护所互动休息，结束第一天。
en: Return to your shelter and rest to end the first day.

zh_CN: 你已经能清楚地说出它。记住这个拼写。
en: You can now say it clearly. Remember this spelling.

zh_CN: 这次说得还不够清楚。没有消耗机会，可以再试一次。
en: That attempt was not clear enough. It costs nothing; try again.

zh_CN: 暂停 · 辅助设置即时生效
方向键、手柄或 Tab 选择 · 确认 · 返回
en: Use arrows, gamepad, or Tab · Confirm · Back

zh_CN: 你在异乡有了第一个立足点
你活过了三天，也第一次被这里的人称作朋友。\n《异乡人 / Stranger》纵向切片完成。
en: You survived three days, and someone here called you a friend.\nStranger vertical slice complete.

zh_CN: 再次确认：清除本次进度
选择一个动作，然后按下新的输入。冲突会要求再次确认交换。
en: Choose an action, then press a new input. Conflicts require a second confirmation to swap.

zh_CN: 请按新的键；按返回可取消。
en: Press a new key; use Back to cancel.

zh_CN: 请按新的手柄按键或推动摇杆；按返回可取消。
en: Press a gamepad button or move a stick; use Back to cancel.

zh_CN: 该输入已用于“%s”。再次按下 %s 以确认交换。
en: That input is used by “%s”. Press %s again to confirm the swap.

zh_CN: 恢复默认会替换当前自定义绑定；焦点已移到返回按钮。
en: Restoring defaults replaces custom bindings; focus moved to Back.

zh_CN: 首轮网页内测暂不包含语音；请用 [G] 手势与居民交流。
en: This web beta does not include voice; use [G] Gesture to talk to residents.

zh_CN: 进度保存在当前浏览器本地；清除站点数据会重置进度。
en: Progress is saved in this browser only; clearing site data resets it.

zh_CN: 问卷链接暂时打不开，请稍后再试。
en: The survey link could not be opened right now. Please try again.

zh_CN: 首轮桌面内测暂不包含语音；请用 [G] 手势与居民交流。
en: This desktop beta does not include voice; use [G] Gesture to talk to residents.

zh_CN: 进度保存在本机用户目录；卸载或删除应用数据会重置进度。
en: Progress is saved in this computer's user directory; removing the app or its data resets it.

zh_CN: 这些补给由居民看管。找到塔维或维什，用英语开口要。
en: The residents watch over these supplies. Find Tavi or Vesh and ask in English.

zh_CN: 蓄水器由奥里看管。用英语向她要一壶水。
en: Ori keeps the reservoir. Ask her for a canteen in English.

zh_CN: 先到市场向米拉问好，再来谈物资。
en: Greet Mira at the market before asking for supplies.

zh_CN: %s 没听懂，这次没有给物资。没关系，再说一次就行。
en: %s did not understand, so nothing was given this time. That is okay; just say it again.

zh_CN: %s 看懂了你的手势，但指了指嘴巴——用英语说出来，才能换到物资。
en: %s understands the gesture but points at their mouth: say it in English to trade for supplies.

zh_CN: %s 听懂了你的表达，给了你两份食物。
en: %s understood your expression and gave you two portions of food.

zh_CN: %s 听懂了你的意思，给了你一份食物。
en: %s understood your meaning and gave you one portion of food.

zh_CN: %s 听懂了你的表达，给了你两块合金零件。
en: %s understood your expression and gave you two alloy parts.

zh_CN: %s 听懂了你的意思，给了一块合金零件。
en: %s understood your meaning and gave you one alloy part.

zh_CN: %s 听懂了你的表达，给你装满水，还分了点干粮。
en: %s understood your expression, filled your canteen, and shared a bite of food.

zh_CN: %s 听懂了你的意思，给你装满了一壶水。
en: %s understood your meaning and filled your canteen.

zh_CN: %s 从你的手势明白了来意，分了最低限度的一份食物。语音可用时，说得越清楚收获越多。
en: %s understood your gesture and shared the minimum portion of food. When speech is available, clearer speech earns more.

zh_CN: %s 从你的手势明白了来意，给了最低限度的一块零件。语音可用时，说得越清楚收获越多。
en: %s understood your gesture and gave the minimum alloy part. When speech is available, clearer speech earns more.

zh_CN: %s 从你的手势明白了来意，给你装了一壶水。
en: %s understood your gesture and filled your canteen.

zh_CN: 水的事还不急。先把前两晚撑过去。
en: The water run can wait. Survive the first two nights first.

zh_CN: 这次表达还不够清楚。没有消耗机会，可以立即免费重说。
en: That expression was not clear enough. It costs nothing; retry is free.

zh_CN: 表达分 %d · 发音 %d · 意思 %d
云端语音尚未激活。可在暂停菜单输入激活码，或使用手势保底。
en: Cloud speech is not activated. Enter an activation code in the pause menu, or use Gesture.

zh_CN: 云端激活已失效。请重新输入激活码，或使用手势保底。
en: Cloud activation expired. Enter a new activation code, or use Gesture.

zh_CN: 你的录音会上传到评分服务器，评分后立即处理，服务器不会留存录音。参考音频留在服务器端，不会上传设备数据。
en: Your recording is uploaded to the scoring server, scored immediately, and never stored. Reference audio stays on the server; no device data is uploaded.

zh_CN: 输入运营者提供的一次性激活码
en: One-time activation code from the operator

zh_CN: 尚未激活。激活码由运营者签发，24 小时内有效、使用一次后失效。
en: Not activated. Codes are operator-issued, valid for 24 hours, and single-use.

zh_CN: 本设备已激活。按住说话即可云端评分。
en: This device is activated. Hold to speak and score in the cloud.

zh_CN: 激活成功。现在可以用语音交流换取物资。
en: Activated. You can now speak to earn supplies.
Cloud scoring is unavailable right now.

zh_CN: 网络或服务器暂时不可用，请稍后再试。
en: The network or server is unavailable right now. Please try again.
The activation code is invalid or expired.

zh_CN: 服务器返回了无法识别的响应。
en: The server returned an unrecognized response.

zh_CN: 激活成功但无法在本机保存令牌。
en: Activated, but the token could not be saved on this device.

zh_CN: 云端语音尚未激活。按 Esc 打开暂停菜单，选择“云评分激活”并输入激活码。
en: Cloud speech is not activated yet. Press Esc, open the pause menu, choose Activate Cloud Scoring, and enter your code.
